# Real-world Commercial WiFi and Bluetooth RF Fingerprinting Dataset

A real-world RF-fingerprinting dataset for commercial Wi-Fi/Bluetooth combo chipsets, captured from two laptops and eight commercial devices with a USRP X300.

## Frequency

**Regimes:** Sub-6 GHz
**Bands:** 2.414 GHz capture center

The receiver records 66.67 MHz of spectrum centered at 2.414 GHz.
